For distinct edges, paths through the junction give ordered radial convolutions. Thus T² f=2Σ(a−t)_+ +4Σb1_(0,b)+Σ_{e≠e'} q_e q_e' (1_(0,s_e)*1_(0,s_e')); normalization follows by integrating ordered edge-pair volumes T². Direct expansion at zero yields T² f'(0+)=k²+4km+4m²−3k−4m, strictly increasing in integer k≥0 for m≥1, recovering k. After known circle-only terms are subtracted, the positive-half-line distributional second derivative plus 4kΣδ_b yields H=(4−2k−4m)Σδ_a +2Σ_{i<j}δ_(a_i+a_j) +4Σ_{i,j}δ_(a_i+b_j). For k≥1 its coefficient C is strictly negative (the k=0 case is already reconstructed from loops); all positive mixed sums involving an unrecovered positive-length pendant occur strictly later than its least length, so inductive subtraction recovers all arms even at exact cancellations. Independently verified 220 exact rational star/rose atom-peeling configurations including m=1,2,3, ties and coincident sums, and analytically rechecked all density coefficients.
